_meta.purpose: Apply covenant_breach detector to all 20 proposed ETF holdings. Per detector spec, fires on disclosure language indicating financial covenant breach in audited financials or EMMA continuing disclosure.
_meta.prototype_catch: Alliance College-Ready Public Schools FY25 audit disclosed non-compliance with financial covenants, waiver obtained (per outputs/CA_CHARTER_INVESTMENT_THESIS_V2.md). Alliance is NOT in this ETF basket but is the canonical test case; the detector was built to formalize that catch.

structural_caveats.k12_go_no_mti_covenants: California K-12 dedicated-tax GO bonds are secured by the SB 222 (2016) statutory lien on ad valorem property tax, NOT by MTI-style financial covenants. The covenant_breach detector is STRUCTURALLY INAPPLICABLE to K-12 GO debt — there is no rate covenant, no DSCR test, no additional bonds test. The detector returns INAPPLICABLE_K12_GO_NO_FINANCIAL_COVENANTS for the 6 K-12 districts. Source: ca_k12_go_universe.json _meta.key_structural_facts.fact_4_sb_222_statutory_lien_is_the_masking_mechanism.
structural_caveats.successor_rda_no_traditional_covenants: Successor Agency tax allocation bonds (TABs) are secured by the ROPS allocation intercept under AB1X 26 / 1484 — a statutory waterfall claim on former tax-increment revenue. Standard TABs may carry an additional-bonds test and parity-lien restrictions, but the dominant security is statutory. Covenant breach disclosure in modern TAB indentures is rare.
structural_caveats.chffa_hospitals_have_strongest_covenants: CHFFA-issued hospital bonds are conduit revenue debt with full MTI covenants (days cash, DSCR, debt to capitalization). The covenant_breach detector is most discriminating here — but we cannot run it without first resolving CUSIPs to underlying hospital obligors (per memory feedback_dd_entity_resolution.md). All 4 CHFFA CUSIPs scored UNVERIFIABLE pending obligor resolution.
structural_caveats.ious_water_and_state_have_rate_covenants: Water districts (MWD, Marina Coast) and revenue-bond issuers (Anaheim Housing Authority for electric utility) typically have rate covenants. State GO and County REV have minimal financial covenants (general obligation pledge is the security).
structural_caveats.hostile_validator_rule: Per feedback memory: silence is NOT 'no breach.' Where we cannot retrieve or text-scrape the audit, the detector returns UNVERIFIABLE. We do NOT default to 'no breach found'. 14 of 20 holdings scored UNVERIFIABLE pending direct audit retrieval.
